Hero.tagline: I change my coat to fit the task. <accent>Never the quality.</accent>
Hero.intro: I design interfaces, write APIs and take products all the way to production. One head for front end, back end and infrastructure — and no losses at the seams.

About.title: I blend into a team <accent>within a week</accent>
About.p1: For seven years I've been building products end to end: from the first Figma sketch to monitoring alerts. A chameleon isn't about camouflage, it's about quickly reading an environment and making it your own.
About.p2: I've worked with three-person startups and with teams of a hundred engineers. I like clear architecture, honest estimates and interfaces that need no explaining.

Skills.title: The full stack spectrum — <accent>in one skin</accent>

canopy.description: Eco-tour booking across the Amazon. Lead full-stack.

ripplePay.description: Payments dashboard for small businesses. Backend and analytics.

fernhouse.description: CMS and storefront for a garden-center chain. Architecture from scratch.

lumenAtlas.description: Interactive 3D map for a natural history museum.

Process.title: First I freeze, <accent>then a precise strike</accent>

observe.title: Observe
observe.text: I study the product, the users and the constraints. I ask the awkward questions before they turn into bugs.

design.title: Design
design.text: Architecture, a clickable prototype and an honest estimate — on a single page.

build.title: Build
build.text: Short iterations and a demo every week. You see progress, not an "almost done" status.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.text: Tests, monitoring, documentation. I hand the project over so the team can run it without me.

Contact.title: Shall we color <accent>your project?</accent>
Contact.intro: I take one or two projects a quarter. Tell me what you're building — I'll reply within a day, even if it's still just an idea on a napkin.
